title: When Coordination Is Avoidable: A Monotonicity Analysis of Organizational Tasks
limitations: Preprint from Johns Hopkins Carey Business School, not yet peer-reviewed. Applies the distributed-systems CALM theorem to Thompson's task interdependence taxonomy. Evaluates 65 APQC enterprise workflows (finding 74% monotonic) and 13,417 O*NET occupational tasks (finding 42% monotonic). The author explicitly notes that monotonicity guarantees only correctness under asynchronous execution, not output quality or organizational coherence.
